settings.title: Large Presence
settings.desc: Framed by your entrance and garlands, its scale makes an immediate, premium first impression on every guest who arrives.

settings.title: Hand-Finished Detail
settings.desc: Every detail - from the tailored coat to the crest on the hat - is painted and finished by hand for a refined, high-end look up close.

settings.title: Your Brand Colours
settings.desc: Choose your colour palette and add your logo to the hat and base so the piece sits seamlessly within your venue's identity.

settings.q: Can you match our exact brand colours?
settings.a: Yes. We hand-paint to your palette and add your logo. Share your brand guide in a commission inquiry.
This is the 2.5 meter height version; we also build at 2 meter and custom heights to suit your space.

settings.q: Can it be reused next year?
settings.a: Yes - it's built to be stored and re-displayed season after season.
We ship worldwide from Dubai, crated for safe transit; local delivery and placement can be arranged.

settings.hero_desc: A 2.5-metre custom nutcracker built for premium spaces - hotels, lobbies and luxury retail. Hand-painted in your brand palette with your logo on the hat and base, it stands as an elegant, photo-worthy festive guardian at your entrance.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your logo, brand colours, height and base text
settings.s1_body: When a standard decoration won't do, this Giant Nutcracker delivers presence. Designed for hotels and luxury venues, it is hand-painted in refined tones, finished by hand, and personalised with your branding - an elegant festive landmark that elevates the whole entrance and draws guests in for a photo.
settings.case_body: Created as a festive centrepiece for a luxury Josette in DIFC, this 2.5-metre nutcracker anchored the venue's seasonal look - colour-matched to the brand and finished to a standard that reads beautifully both day and night.
settings.case_quote: Its an impressive display to welcome our visitor. The colours matched our branding perfectly.
settings.prov_p: For generations the nutcracker has stood as a festive symbol of welcome and protection. Built tall and tailored to your brand, it becomes a centrepiece your guests remember. The guardian of the festive season.
